title: Argentina: from the Malvinas war to democracy
goal: I can tell how the Argentine dictatorship ended, contrasting the preterite and the imperfect.

items: I can tell what happened in Argentina in 1982 and 1983, contrasting the preterite and the imperfect.
I can name the four military presidents of 1976 to 1983.
I can say what happened in the Malvinas war and what it did to the regime.
I can use the preterite for events and the imperfect for the background.
I can use the new words for island, fleet and troops.
